content: UDP datagram sizing: theoretical max payload 65507 bytes; Ethernet MTU 1500 gives 1472-byte safe IPv4 payload; datagrams above MTU rely on IP fragmentation where losing one fragment loses the whole datagram (loss amplification ~1-(1-p)^N); RFC 4963 documents reassembly failures at high data rates; Linux ipfrag_high_thresh/ipfrag_time can drop fragmented datagrams under load; QUIC chose 1200 as safe floor. For sup-kv: DataReplication carrying up to 60KiB values in ONE datagram is fragmented into ~40 fragments on 1500 MTU - a real loss amplifier the design's 1400-byte sync_chunk_bytes already implicitly acknowledges for DataSync but not DataReplication.
